description: This file is a PHP class that defines an extension controller for managing currency extensions within the OpenCart system. It includes methods for listing available currencies, installing, and uninstalling currency extensions, and handling related logic such as permissions, autoloading controllers/models, and rendering views for the admin interface.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A controller class for managing currency extensions in the admin interface, including listing, installing, and uninstalling currencies.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the list of currency extensions available and installed.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the list of currency extensions, including their status, and links for install/uninstall/edit actions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a new currency extension, including permission check, copying language files, and registering permissions.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a currency extension, including permission check and removing extension entries.
